props.tex: \begin{aligned}&\nabla f(\mathbf x)=\begin{pmatrix}4\\5\end{pmatrix},\qquad \mathbf u=\begin{pmatrix}0.6\\0.8\end{pmatrix}\\D_{\mathbf u}f(\mathbf x)=\nabla f(\mathbf x)^\top\mathbf u&=\sum_{j=1}^2\partial_jf(\mathbf x)\,u_j=\partial_1f(\mathbf x)\,u_1+\partial_2f(\mathbf x)\,u_2\\&=4\cdot0.6+5\cdot0.8\\&=2.4+4.0\\&=6.4\end{aligned}
